description: Turn up to 1,000 characters of text into natural speech (Kokoro 82M) and return it as an MP3 (64 kbit/s, mono, base64). 38 voices in American and British English, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese; the voice picks the language. Speed 0.5 to 2.0. Longer text: split it at sentence ends and call once per part.

text.description: What to say, in the voice's language. At most 1,000 characters.

voice.description: Voice id. a/b = American/British English, e = Spanish, f = French, h = Hindi, i = Italian, p = Brazilian Portuguese; second letter f/m = female/male.

name: speak
